reason: The cited evidence shows that single-phase high-entropy diborides were fabricated and that one (HEB#1) had better oxidation resistance than most individual diborides, but it does not show that adding an HEA to ZrB2 reduces the preparation temperature; in fact, all specimens except CrB2 were sintered at the same high temperature, and the hypothesis proposes a composite, not a single-phase HEA diboride.
premises: HEA diborides can be synthesized as single-phase materials
HEA diborides exhibit improved oxidation resistance over individual diborides
HEA diborides maintain structural integrity at high temperatures
Adding an HEA component reduces the required preparation temperature
